title: Zencoder Rules Format
description: JSON Schema for Zencoder .zencoder/rules format with optional YAML frontmatter

frontmatter.description: Optional YAML frontmatter enclosed in --- markers

description.description: Brief description of what the rule covers

globs.description: File patterns where the rule applies (e.g., ['*.md', '*.mdx'])

alwaysApply.description: Set to true if rule should always be active

content.description: Markdown content following the frontmatter. Standard markdown with headings, lists, code blocks, etc.

examples.content:
# TypeScript Standards

- Use strict mode
- Prefer interfaces over types
- Always define return types

# General Coding Guidelines

These guidelines apply to all code.

- Write clear, self-documenting code
- Add comments for complex logic
